title: Abu Dhabi's MBZUAI and the company Inception42 have launched Jais 3, a set of six open Arabic AI language models plus an Arabic speech recognition model.
key_facts: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) and Inception42 introduced Jais 3
Six open language models, 900 million to 375 billion parameters, plus Jais Speech
Trained on Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, for more than 400 million Arabic speakers
Built on K2 Horizon, IFM's open-source model fleet released September 2026; made with Cerebras Systems
Evaluated on 24 Arabic benchmarks released publicly; largest model leads open models on agentic tasks (developers' claim)
quote_evidence: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence's (MBZUAI) Institute of Foundation Models (IFM), and Inception42 have introduced Jais 3, a fleet of models built for Arabic
The fleet pairs six open language models, from 900 million to 375 billion parameters, with Jais Speech, a speech recognition model for Arabic and its dialects.
Jais 3 and Jais Speech are available today on Hugging Face, with deployment support for vLLM and SGLang.
why_it_matters_hint: Open Arabic models for speech and agents, including dialects.
